2608.12429.title: SynWeaver: Website-Prior Task and Trajectory Co-Synthesis for Web Agents
2608.12429.paper_summary: Web agents often struggle to generalize to unseen websites because they lack website-specific supervision. Recent exploration-based data synthesis methods reduce manual annotation, but they still face two key limitations: they often fail to cover the full functionality of a website, and without sufficient website prior knowledge, they tend to propose hallucinated tasks, which in turn limits the diversity and efficiency of downstream trajectory synthesis. We present \textbf{SynWeaver}, a website-prior task-trajectory co-synthesis framework designed to address these challenges. SynWeaver first performs structured website exploration and constructs a website map that covers a broad set of functionally distinct page states and executable interactions on the target website. It then derives page-level and transition-level supervision from this map to train a UI-aware model with website-specific priors, enabling more grounded task proposals. Finally, SynWeaver performs collaborative task-trajectory synthesis, jointly updating the task and execution trajectory when they become inconsistent, and then verifies and repairs the collected results to produce executable, semantically aligned supervision. Experiments on WebArena and WebVoyager demonstrate that SynWeaver consistently outperforms strong synthesis baselines and yields more effective supervision for both in-domain and out-of-domain generalization.
2608.12429.paper_summary_zh: Web代理通常難以對未見過的網站進行泛化，因為它們缺乏網站特定的監督。最近的探索性數據合成方法減少了手動標註，但仍然面臨兩個主要限制：它們往往無法涵蓋網站的全部功能，並且在缺乏足夠的網站先驗知識的情況下，它們傾向於提出虛構的任務，這反過來限制了下游軌跡合成的多樣性和效率。我們提出了\textbf{SynWeaver}，一個旨在解決這些挑戰的網站先驗任務軌跡共同合成框架。SynWeaver首先進行結構化的網站探索，並構建一個網站地圖，涵蓋目標網站上廣泛的功能性不同的頁面狀態和可執行的互動。然後，它從這個地圖中推導出頁面級和轉換級的監督，以訓練一個具有網站特定先驗的UI感知模型，從而實現更具根據的任務提議。最後，SynWeaver執行協作任務軌跡合成，當任務和執行軌跡不一致時共同更新，然後驗證和修復收集的結果，以生成可執行的、語義對齊的監督。在WebArena和WebVoyager上的實驗表明，SynWeaver始終超越強大的合成基線，並為域內和域外泛化產生更有效的監督。
